title.en: “Torque Calculator” leaves Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW and 26 m³/h on the Electric 50 Concrete Pump row
title.zh: 「扭矩 计算器」不改不要把柴油目录行抄到电动订单上这一行里的「电动50和柴油40都印 2800 kg。」

description.en: Electric 50 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-50-concrete-pump. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW and 26 m³/h Electric 50 and Diesel 40 both print 2800 kg
description.zh: 不要把柴油目录行抄到电动订单上见 /products/electric-50-concrete-pump。电动50和柴油40都印 2800 kg。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h 和两行石子距离。

h1.en: Torque Calculator does not retitle the Electric 50 Concrete Pump cells
h1.zh: 「扭矩 计算器」并不改写不要把柴油目录行抄到电动订单上的格子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 50 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-50-concrete-pump. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW and 26 m³/h. Electric 50 and Diesel 40 both print 2800 kg. Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h and two stone rows. Electric 50 is 55 kW electric, 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Weights are 3300 kg and 6000 kg, motors 90 kW and 110 kW. Diesel 40 is 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Electric 60 and Electric 80 both print 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa and 150 m / 450 m. Electric 50 prints a 55 kW motor, 26 m³/h and three stone-distance rows. The section title “Power and Torque of Body in Angular Motion” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是不要把柴油目录行抄到电动订单上的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-50-concrete-pump。电动50和柴油40都印 2800 kg。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h 和两行石子距离。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW 和 26 m³/h。电动50印 55 kW 电机、26 m³/h 和三行石子距离。电动60和电动80都印外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。电动50是电动 55 kW，外形 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。重量是 3300 kg 和 6000 kg，电机是 90 kW 和 110 kW。柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 450 m。柴油40是 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h，外形 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。节标题「功率与扭矩的物体 在 角 运动」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

body.en: For Electric 50 Concrete Pump, the heading “Power and Torque of Body in Angular Motion” does not replace a cell. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW and 26 m³/h. Electric 50 is 55 kW electric, 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Electric 60 and Electric 80 both print 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm.
body.zh: 对不要把柴油目录行抄到电动订单上而言，标题「功率与扭矩的物体 在 角 运动」并不替换任何格子。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW 和 26 m³/h。电动50是电动 55 kW，外形 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。电动60和电动80都印外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。

body.en: Electric 50 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Torque Calculator”. Electric 50 and Diesel 40 both print 2800 kg. Weights are 3300 kg and 6000 kg, motors 90 kW and 110 kW. Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa and 150 m / 450 m.
body.zh: 不要把柴油目录行抄到电动订单上不因标题「扭矩 计算器」而改动。电动50和柴油40都印 2800 kg。重量是 3300 kg 和 6000 kg，电机是 90 kW 和 110 kW。柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 450 m。

question.en: Does “Power and Torque of Body in Angular Motion” replace Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW and 26 m³/h?
question.zh: 「功率与扭矩的物体 在 角 运动」会替换「电动50和柴油40都印 2800 kg。」吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW and 26 m³/h remains the printed wording for Electric 50 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。电动50和柴油40都印 2800 kg。仍是不要把柴油目录行抄到电动订单上已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Electric 50 and Diesel 40 both print 2800 kg belong on the Electric 50 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 不要把柴油目录行抄到电动订单上这一行里，「电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h 和两行石子距离。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-50-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-50-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Torque Calculator” add to Electric 50 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「扭矩 计算器」给不要把柴油目录行抄到电动订单上增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/angular-velocity-acceleration-power-torque-d_1397.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/angular-velocity-acceleration-power-torque-d_1397.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
